extracted.intended_audience: businesses regulated by the FTC, attorneys, compliance officers, consumer advocates, and members of the public interested in FTC rulemaking or submitting comments
extracted.subtask_description: An index page summarizing active and proposed Federal Trade Commission rules across multiple subject areas (consumer protection, competition, labeling, privacy, telemarketing, etc.), providing short descriptions and links to rule texts and files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negative Option Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission's 'Rule Concerning the Use of Prenotification Negative Option Plans' (Negative Option Rule) — public comment sought on need for amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summary indicates the rule governs negative option plans where consumers are charged unless they take action to decline; page invites public comment on potential amendments. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Noncompete Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Noncompete Rule adopts a comprehensive ban on new noncompetes with all workers, including senior executives, as an unfair method of competition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final rule text (file linked) establishes prohibition on entering new noncompete clauses; applies broadly to workers and characterizes such clauses as an unfair method of competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safeguards Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires financial institutions under FTC jurisdiction to have measures in place to keep customer information secure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Companies must develop safeguards for customer data in addition to their own policies; the rule prescribes obligations for protecting consumer information. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule (COPPA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Imposes requirements on operators of websites or online services directed to children under 13, and on operators with actual knowledge they collect personal information from children under 13.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: COPPA specifies parental consent, notice, and other protections for collecting information from children; final rule amendments linked for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: HSR Rules (Hart-Scott-Rodino Rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outlines requirements for the premerger notification process under the Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) Act to enable the FTC and DOJ to review certain transactions before closing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HSR rules set thresholds, filing requirements, waiting periods, and transaction-reporting procedures required for premerger notification. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Impersonation of Government and Businesses Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule addressing unlawful impersonation of government agencies and businesses in communications with consumers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summary indicates the rule targets deceptive impersonation practices; full text available via link for specifics on prohibited conduct and enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telemarketing Sales Rule (TSR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires telemarketers to make specific disclosures of material information, prohibits misrepresentations, and sets limits on the times telemarketers may call consumers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TSR prescribes required disclosures, bans deceptive statements in telemarketing, and establishes calling time restrictions and other consumer protections. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule on Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials (Reviews and Testimonials Rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) proposing a rule governing the use of consumer reviews and testimonials in advertising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The NPRM would specify requirements or prohibitions for how marketers may present consumer reviews and testimonials to avoid misleading consumers; public comment invited. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy and Water Use Labeling for Consumer Products (Energy Labeling Rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls for Energy Guide labels stating a product's estimated annual operating cost and energy consumption and a range for comparing the highest and lowest models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule prescribes yellow Energy Guide labeling format, required content (estimated annual operating cost, energy consumption), and comparative ranges to inform consumers. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking: Unfair or Deceptive Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed Trade Regulation Rule would prohibit unfair or deceptive practices relating to fees for goods or services, specifically misrepresenting the total costs of a purchase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposal targets deceptive fee disclosures and requires truthful representation of total costs; page indicates NPRM status and invites comment. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair Credit Reporting Act: Risk-Based Pricing Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule-related material implementing risk-based pricing notice obligations under the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides requirements for notices to consumers when risk-based pricing is used, including content and timing of disclosures. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair Credit Reporting Act: Model Forms and Disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Model forms and disclosure requirements under the Fair Credit Reporting Act for consumer notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies model language and formats for required consumer disclosures under FCRA-related rules; links to texts for exact forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair Credit Reporting Act: Affiliate Marketing
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule material pertaining to affiliate marketing restrictions and disclosures under the Fair Credit Reporting Act framework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses limits and disclosure obligations when consumer reports or information are used for affiliate marketing; full text linked for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: R-Value Rule (Home Insulation Labeling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires home insulation manufacturers, professional installers, and new home sellers to label insulation with R-value information and related disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formally 'Trade Regulation Rule Concerning the Labeling and Advertising of Home Insulation' — sets labeling and advertising requirements to prevent deceptive claims about insulation performance. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Test Procedures and Labeling Standards for Recycled Oil
rubrics_metrics.description: Prescribes testing procedures and labeling standards for recycled oil pursuant to the Energy Policy and Conservation Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule mandates specific test procedures and labeling content to ensure accurate representation of recycled oil products. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Jewelry, Precious Metals, and Pewter Industries Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Trade regulation material addressing labeling and advertising requirements for jewelry, precious metals, and pewter industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets disclosure and labeling standards to prevent misrepresentation of materials, provenance, and metal content; full text linked.

rubrics_metrics.name: 16 CFR Subchapter A (Parts 0-16) - Commission Rules of Organization, Procedure, and Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Commission rules governing the FTC's organization, procedures, and practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains procedural requirements for FTC operations, adjudications, rulemaking processes, filings, and practice before the Commission. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Textile Fiber Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires certain textiles sold in the United States to carry labels disclosing generic names and percentages by weight of constituent fibers, among other information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies mandatory label content, format, and exemptions to ensure consumers receive accurate fiber-content information. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Wool Products Labeling Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires labels on wool products disclosing the manufacturer's or marketer's name, the country where the product was processed or manufactured, and related information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets required label elements and standards to prevent deception in wool product marketing and labeling. (Text of Rule linked.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Fuel Economy Advertising for New Automobiles (Guide)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guide assisting automobile manufacturers and dealers to avoid deceptive fuel economy claims and to use fuel economy information truthfully in advertising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides recommended practices and examples for fuel-economy advertising, including truthfulness standards and how to present fuel economy estimates to consumers. (Guide linked.)
